en.text:
Direct Melee Hits on <arc/>Jolted targets <arc/>Blinds them for ? seconds.

Casting your Class Ability grants <arc/>'Lethal Current' for 10 seconds, which is consumed on your next melee hit.

<arc/>Lethal Current increases Melee Lunge Distance to 7 meters, causes your next Direct Melee Hit to apply <arc/>Jolt, and triggers a damaging 6 meter radius <arc/>Arc Explosion.

Lethal Current can consume and receive the benefits of <arc/>Combination Blow.
